words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 那位女人正在图书馆安静地看书。(Nà wèi nǚrén zhèngzài túshūguǎn ānjìng de kànshū.) — That woman is quietly reading a book in the library.
他的女儿今年刚满七岁。(Tā de nǚ'ér jīnnián gāng mǎn qī suì.) — His daughter just turned seven years old this year.
现代社会非常重视女性的权利。(Xiàndài shèhuì fēicháng zhòngshì nǚxìng de quánlì.) — Modern society attaches great importance to women's rights.
他打算在周末陪女朋友看电影。(Tā dǎsuàn zài zhōumò péi nǚpéngyou kàn diànyǐng.) — He plans to accompany his girlfriend to watch a movie this weekend.
我们坚决反对任何虐待动物的行为。(Wǒmen jiānjué fǎnduì rènhé nüèdài dòngwù de xíngwéi.) — We firmly oppose any act of abusing animals.
春天到了，草地上长满了绿色的嫩芽。(Chūntiān dào le, cǎodì shang zhǎng mǎn le lǜsè de nènyá.) — Spring has arrived, and the grass is full of green sprouts.
他们计划明年夏天去欧洲旅游。(Tāmen jìhuà míngnián xiàtiān qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu.) — They plan to travel to Europe next summer.
如果你有法律疑问，可以咨询专业律师。(Rúguǒ nǐ yǒu fǎlǜ yíwèn, kěyǐ zīxún zhuānyè lǜshī.) — If you have legal questions, you can consult a professional lawyer.
火车站里有很多准备出发的旅客。(Huǒchēzhàn li yǒu hěn duō zhǔnbèi chūfā de lǚkè.) — There are many passengers ready to depart at the train station.
制定合理的学习策略能够提高效率。(Zhìdìng hélǐ de xuéxí cèlüè nénggòu tígāo xiàolǜ.) — Formulating a reasonable study strategy can improve efficiency.
请用这个生词造一个完整的句子。(Qǐng yòng zhè ge shēngcí zào yí ge wánzhěng de jùzi.) — Please make a complete sentence using this new word.
他决定每天早起背诵十个汉语词汇。(Tā juédìng měitiān zǎoqǐ bèisòng shí ge hànyǔ cíhuì.) — He decided to wake up early every day to recite ten Chinese words.
我觉得学中文既有挑战又很有趣。(Wǒ juéde xué zhōngwén jì yǒu tiǎozhàn yòu hěn yǒuqù.) — I feel that learning Chinese is both challenging and interesting.
学校将在下周举行运动会。(Xuéxiào jiāng zài xià zhōu jǔxíng yùndònghuì.) — The school will hold a sports meet next week.
这支军队驻扎在边境地区保护安全。(Zhè zhī jūnduì zhùzhā zài biānjìng dìqū bǎohù ānquán.) — This army is stationed in the border region to safeguard security.
我们打算明天下午去超市买新鲜水果。(Wǒmen dǎsuàn míngtiān xiàwǔ qù chāoshì mǎi xīnxiān shuǐguǒ.) — We plan to go to the supermarket tomorrow afternoon to buy fresh fruit.
他已经把今天的作业全部完成了。(Tā yǐjīng bǎ jīntiān de zuòyè quánbù wánchéng le.) — He has already completed all of today's homework.
这条蓝色的裙子非常漂亮。(Zhè tiáo lánsè de qúnzi fēicháng piàoliang.) — This blue skirt is very pretty.
这道数学题确实需要仔细思考。(Zhè dào shùxuétí quèshí xūyào zǐxì sīkǎo.) — This math problem indeed requires careful thought.
因为下大雨，明天的野餐活动取消了。(Yīnwèi xià dàyǔ, míngtiān de yěcān huódòng qǔxiāo le.) — Because of heavy rain, tomorrow's picnic activity has been cancelled.
认真学习是取得好成绩的关键。(Rènzhēn xuéxí shì qǔdé hǎo chéngjì de guānjiàn.) — Studying conscientiously is the key to achieving good grades.
教室里坐着二十位专心听讲的学生。(Jiàoshì li zuò zhe èrshí wèi zhuānxīn tīngjiǎng de xuésheng.) — Twenty students listening attentively are sitting in the classroom.
学好一门语言需要坚持不懈的练习。(Xuéhǎo yì mén yǔyán xūyào jiānchí-búxiè de liànxí.) — Mastering a language requires persistent practice.
运动员每天都要接受高强度的体能训练。(Yùndòngyuán měitiān dōu yào jiēshòu gāo qiángdù de tǐnéng xùnliàn.) — The athletes undergo high-intensity physical training every day.
面对人生道路，每个人都有权利做出自己的选择。(Miànduì rénshēng dàolù, měi gè rén dōu yǒu quánlì zuò chū zìjǐ de xuǎnzé.) — Facing life's path, everyone has the right to make their own choice.
